changeSet.author: bielik-lab
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto; CREATE TABLE corpora ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE TABLE training_examples ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), corpus_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES corpora(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, split TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (split IN ('train', 'validation', 'test')), messages JSONB NOT NULL, source TEXT, metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, embedding vector, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX training_examples_corpus_split_idx ON training_examples (corpus_id, split); CREATE INDEX training_examples_metadata_idx ON training_examples USING GIN (metadata);
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS training_examples; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS corpora;
